substantive_relations: Refines the known static minimax/Jensen/catalog bound, not its first proof.
All claims quantify over every optimal comparison tuple and every optimal correlated dual, with query outcome unobserved.
Rigidity fixes the entire client-load vector across all optimal duals, not topic counts, order, query distribution or full catalog intersections.
At n=1 arbitrary q is multiplied by zero; positive-support g=v applies only at n>=2.
Generic successor checks replace v with the actual cap of arbitrary Q; full positive support makes support-min cap equal theta numerically but does not certify optimal Q or the expectation-cap bound.
Two finite audit domains are distinct: author 12/1308/1299/700 vs successor 80/7/1275/1. Historical aggregate byte identity does not certify identical old random case inputs.
Actual uniform deletion of the padding SPE is a concrete legal but nonoptimal Q: F(T)=6 while true v<=5; it cannot inherit nonnegative deltas with true v.
Only if a sharp instance SPE has actual last-prefix load equal L does the conditional W>=nv follow. General half and dynamic aggregate v are not inferred.
